source_scope: Bentzen2003 Tumour oxygenation assessed by18F-fluoromisonidazole PET and polarographic needle electrodes in human soft tissue tumours, RadiotherOncol67:339–344
Nordsmark2001 Hypoxia in human soft tissue sarcomas: adverse impact on survival and no association with p53 mutations, BJC84:1070–1075
question: Do the actual original measured PET/electrode cohorts authenticate an EMC specimen-to-measurement link with a consequential unreported practical calibration contrast beyond their published global conclusions?
before_values: Retrieve exact-title/DOI metadata and only genuine public original publisher/PMC/archive links. Inspect all histotype/case IDs, measured assay/conditions/timing/ROI/electrode tracks/biopsy/protein pairing and cohort overlap fields. Keep all per-case pO2/PET/proxy values masked. No numerical stage unless one useful source-backed unreported contrast and all relevant condition coverage are frozen separately.
eligibility: Author explicit EMC histotype and actual matching specimen/subject/measurement map required; generic sarcoma/CHS/Other unresolved. Historic pathology and absent NR4A3 confirmation limits retained. No case order or numerical code inference.
use: Only a linked oxygen-specific or source-calibrated measurement discrepancy with independent replication and real assay decision relevance could motivate a new EMC measurement study; one descriptive case or known global PET/electrode discordance is insufficient.
strongest_alternatives: FMISO delivery/perfusion, uptake time and viable fraction differ from measured electrode pO2
Spatial track sampling versus whole-lesion uptake and biopsy times are not automatically matched
Previously published calibration or discrepancy already answers contrast
Shared patients/tracks/conditions across42/30/16 subsets inflate evidence
Missing public individual condition map or unreported data unavailable
stop: At15min close source gate. No actual useful EMC-linked contrast => shelf quantitative execution, retain exact pending/unavailable/unsuitable distinctions. No source access success inferred from citation, no absencebiology/exhaustion claim.
restrictions: Quiet API/files/public PDFtext only; no UI/images/OCR/browser before14UTC
No guessed source URLs/unchanged failed route retries/private accounts/access bypass
